title: Quant Quality Stability Index (QQSI) and task-specific scorer implementation
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Implement a cohesive quality-metrics layer for FP8/INT8 quantized profiles that produces a single stability signal (QQSI) plus a suite of task-specific scorers. The goal is to surface regressions introduced by quantization or calibration and to enable automated gating for rollouts. This ticket covers metric definitions, scorer registry, statistical testing, CI integration, and a lightweight dashboard feed for Observatory.
acceptance_criteria: Define QQSI: composite index that combines normalized perplexity delta, weighted MMLU-style task performance delta, BLEU/ROUGE shift, and calibration fidelity score into a single 0-100 stability scale

Implement per-task scorers for: perplexity (language modelling), MMLU-style multiple-choice accuracy, BLEU and ROUGE for summarization/translation tasks, and at least two task-specific scorers (QA F1, code-execution correctness) with pluggable weighting
Implement paired-sample statistical testing (bootstrap CI and paired t-test where applicable) for metric deltas and expose p-values and effect sizes alongside deltas
Record layer-wise quantization noise profiles and a derived Calibration Fidelity Score (CFS) that quantifies calibration/activation distribution drift

Expose scorer outputs and QQSI in eval CI as JSON artifacts and wire the primary QQSI metric to the rollout gating rule in the Console (canary fail if QQSI falls below threshold or p-value < 0.01 with negative effect size)
Provide a short demo notebook and a Confluence doc describing metric formulas, recommended thresholds for FP8/INT8, and examples of interpreting QQSI changes
Add basic Observatory dashboard tile that shows QQSI trend, top 3 contributing sub-metrics, and per-task breakdown for recent releases
tasks: spec: formalize QQSI formula and normalization scheme and publish to Confluence
impl: scorer registry and plugin interface for new scorers
impl: perplexity scorer that supports token-level and sequence-level aggregation and delta normalization
impl: MMLU-style harness adaptor that produces per-subject accuracy and aggregated weighted score
impl: BLEU/ROUGE wrappers with paired-bootstrapped CI and delta computation
impl: QA F1 scorer and a lightweight code-execution correctness scorer (sandboxed)
impl: calibration fidelity pipeline to compute CFS from calibration artifacts produced during calibration runs
data: curate reference workloads and small shadow datasets for quick CI runs (fast, medium, full)
infra: add JSON artifact schema and storage path for eval CI outputs
dashboard: prototype QQSI tile in Observatory with drilldowns
integration: hook QQSI artifact to rollout policies in Console and add canary gating rule
tests: unit tests for scorer outputs and statistical tests; end-to-end verification using a synthetic quantization delta
